purpose: PBP player-cohort feature diagnostic (READ-ONLY): tests whether six offense-vs-defense UNIT-TYPE structure families (pass EPA, rush EPA, OL/DL pressure, big-play %, red-zone TD, 3rd-down) add signal BEYOND the 12-pool level diffs (elo_diff / ewm_ypp_diff / ewm_net_pts_diff). QB-strata protocol (796802c): strata + pre-registered in-sample ceiling bar; no pipeline built unless a family survives.
scope: nfl-backend + data_delivery only; decided OOF rows only (1,376 shared universe, never slate rows); no production/model/feature change (FEATURE_COLUMNS untouched).

as_of_convention.fallback_chain: within-season ewm(hl=2) over prior weeks >= 4 -> prior-season (S-1) weekly mean >= 5 weeks -> global league-mean carry

pairing.ceiling_model: M0 = logit(p); Mf = logit(p) + M_h + M_a (in-sample, same 1,376 rows)

family_definitions.F1_pass_epa: OFF mean EPA/pass play; DEF mean EPA allowed on opponent pass plays
family_definitions.F2_rush_epa: OFF mean EPA/run play; DEF mean EPA allowed on opponent run plays
family_definitions.F3_pressure: OFF OL pressure-rate allowed (PFR starter row: pressures per dropback); DEF DL pressure generated = opponent's OL rate in the same game
family_definitions.F4_big_play: OFF share of scrimmage plays that are big (run > 10 yds; pass air_yards >= 20, or yards >= 20 when air_yards NaN); DEF mirrored on opponent plays
family_definitions.F5_redzone_td: OFF red-zone TD rate per possession drive (RZ = yardline_100 <= 20); DEF mirrored
family_definitions.F6_third_down: OFF mean EPA on 3rd-down plays; DEF mean EPA allowed on opponent 3rd-down plays

ceiling.label: IN-SAMPLE explanatory fit with as-of unit values on the same games the model consumes — an UPPER BOUND; serve-time noise lowers achievable gain

rules.GO: R2 <= 0.95 AND strata gap >= 0.008 AND ceiling delta <= -0.004 (or R2 >= 0.02)
rules.RE_TEST_CANDIDATE: R2 <= 0.95 and strata gap in [0.002, 0.008) or ceiling delta in (-0.004, -0.002]

headline: No family GO. None of the six unit-structure pairings is redundant (max R2 vs served inputs 0.03-0.20) and none is worth-having (all in-sample ceiling deltas -0.0003..-0.0014, far above the -0.004 GO bar). Five STOP; F3 pressure is the sole RE_TEST_CANDIDATE (strata logloss gap +0.0053 in [0.002, 0.008) but ceiling -0.0006). The binary's errors do NOT concentrate in structural-pairing games; big-play mismatch games are BETTER calibrated (gap -0.0412). Cohort structure is not the missing axis at this sample size.

judgment_calls.family_semantics: each family measured OFF (unit's own weekly stat) and DEF (allowed vs opponent plays / generated); game pairing M_h = asof_off(home) - asof_def(away), M_a mirrored; strata score = max(|M_h|, |M_a|)
judgment_calls.as_of: strictly-prior ewm halflife-2 over same-season prior weeks (floor >= 4), prior-season (S-1) weekly mean >= 5 weeks fallback, global league-mean carry — QB-strata precedent (documented; league constant is diagnostic baseline only)
judgment_calls.F3_pressure_source: nflreadpy load_pfr_advstats (PFR weekly); the team-week OL rate = the STARTING QB's protection row (max implied dropbacks = pressures / pressure rate); DL generated = the opponent's OL rate in the same game
judgment_calls.re_test_band: RE_TEST_CANDIDATE band implemented as strata gap in [0.002, 0.008) OR ceiling delta in (-0.004, -0.002] — F3's 0.0053 gap lands in the between-zone below GO's 0.008
judgment_calls.sign_stability: M_h/M_a coefficient signs at ~0 logloss gain are collinear-unstable and NOT interpretable; the ceiling delta is the gate

follow_ons.F3_pressure: RE_TEST_CANDIDATE — re-test when scored n grows (2026 decided rows, ~272/yr); needs serve-time PFR pressure (network + delay) and a per-fold gated arm before any build
follow_ons.others: five STOP families dismissed for now; the diagnostic reruns cheaply on the same harness once 2026 decided rows exist
follow_ons.direction: as in QB strata (796802c) and calibration arms (e3aeece/fc4f4bd): the model's residual error concentrates on AGGREGATE-quality extremes, not unit-structure or player-availability strata
